concurrency_and_state: TaskService.gI() (lines 388-393) uses unsynchronized lazy initialization without volatile/double-checked locking.
addDoneSubTask() (lines 1539-1575) synchronizes on player.playerTask and invokes sendNextTaskMain(player) while holding that lock.
paySideTask() (lines 2035-2145) and payClanTask() (lines 2324-2348) do NOT synchronize on player.playerTask or player.clan when checking isDone(), granting rewards, and calling reset().
checkDoneTaskTrungUy() (lines 914-936) iterates Zone.getPlayers() across DoanhTrai zones and calls doneTask() on other clan members' Player instances.
cross_module_questions: Verify ConstTask.java bit-shift definitions against TaskService.isCurrentTask() / getIdTask() (lines 1694, 1702) where `(id << 10) + index << 1` evaluates as `((id << 10) + index) << 1` due to `+` having higher precedence than `<<`.
Verify whether ConstTask.TASK_24_2 is intentionally omitted from TRUONG_LAO_GURU (lines 607-621) and VUA_VEGETA (lines 622-636) in checkDoneTaskTalkNpc(), whereas QUY_LAO_KAME (line 605) includes it.
Verify Client Unity Msg43 handler matches sendUpdateCountSubTask() (lines 516-554) writing count + x_hint + y_hint (3 shorts).

findings.impact: Concurrent reward claims (e.g., rapid packet clicks) can pass isDone() multiple times before reset() executes at line 2139 / 2328, duplicating gold, ruby, upgrade stones, lucky wheel tickets, charms, or clan capsuleClan/memberPoint/clanPoint.
findings.root_cause: paySideTask() and payClanTask() check sideTask.isDone() / clanTask.isDone(), grant all rewards, and only call reset() at the end without synchronizing on player.playerTask (or player.clan).
findings.title: Missing synchronization in paySideTask() and payClanTask() allows race-condition reward duplication

findings.impact: Namec and Xayda players cannot complete or turn in TASK_24_2 at Trưởng Lão Guru or Vua Vegeta, blocking main quest progression if TASK_24_2 targets NPC_QUY_LAO.
findings.root_cause: checkDoneTaskTalkNpc() includes doneTask(player, ConstTask.TASK_24_2) under ConstNpc.QUY_LAO_KAME (line 605) but omits it from ConstNpc.TRUONG_LAO_GURU (lines 607-621) and ConstNpc.VUA_VEGETA (lines 622-636).
findings.title: TASK_24_2 missing from Namec and Xayda elder NPCs in checkDoneTaskTalkNpc()

findings.impact: If taskId in ClanTaskTemplate does not equal its index in Manager.CLAN_TASKS_TEMPLATE, getClanTaskTemplateById() returns the wrong template or throws IndexOutOfBoundsException.
findings.root_cause: getClanTaskTemplateById(int id) calls Manager.CLAN_TASKS_TEMPLATE.get(id) directly by list index without bounds checking or iterating to match t.id == id (unlike getSideTaskTemplateById).
findings.title: Unchecked list index lookup in getClanTaskTemplateById()

findings.impact: Unnecessary CPU and GC allocation on every main task load/transition due to compiling 14 regex Patterns per transformName() call.
findings.root_cause: transformName() uses String.replaceAll() 14 times per invocation instead of literal String.replace(), compiling a regex Pattern each time.
findings.title: transformName() uses regex replaceAll() 14 times per call instead of literal replace()

findings.impact: Direct ruby += rubyReward in rewardDoneTask() bypasses Inventory.addRuby() cap/validation checks used in paySideTask().
findings.root_cause: rewardDoneTask() directly mutates player.inventory.ruby += rubyReward instead of calling player.inventory.addRuby(rubyReward).
findings.title: rewardDoneTask() mutates player.inventory.ruby directly without using addRuby()

key_classes.name: TaskService
key_classes.responsibility: Singleton service managing main storyline tasks, daily Bo Mong side tasks, clan tasks, achievement/title progress hooks, and task reward distribution.

module_summary: TaskService.java (2425 lines) handles main task progression, NPC/mob/boss/item/map completion hooks, daily SideTask assignment/rewards, ClanTask assignment/rewards, and achievement counters. Key issues found include unsynchronized reward claim paths in paySideTask/payClanTask, missing TASK_24_2 for Namec/Xayda elders, unchecked list-index lookup in getClanTaskTemplateById, and regex replaceAll overhead in transformName.
